question_en: Implement saha_ionized_fraction(T_eV, n_total, chi): Given the electron temperature T_eV (eV), total particle number density n_total (m^-3), and ionization energy chi (eV), calculate the ionization fraction x=n_{i+1}/n_total of a hydrogen plasma (two-level Saha, quasi-neutrality condition n_e=n_{i+1}, the statistical weight ratio g is taken as 1). question_en:
Implement two functions:
(1) rt_growth(k, A, g, L, Va, alpha=0.9, beta=3.1) returns the Takabe ablatively corrected Rayleigh-Taylor (RT) growth rate α√(Akg/(1+AkL))−βkV_a;
(2) stabilization_wavenumber(A, g, L, Va, alpha=0.9, beta=3.1) returns the critical wavenumber k at which the growth rate is zero (analytical root finding).
Only standard libraries are allowed.
